name: 37139-imagecaption-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8B params: a 27-layer vision tower (patch 16, spatial merge 2) over a 36-layer language model. ~17 GB of safetensors. Full detail is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 20%, bound 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image captioning: ONE 512x512 image plus a 32-token instruction per request, 16 output tokens with `ignore_eos` so every answer is exactly that length. Images are row-index seeded, so no two requests carry the same pixels.
purpose: An image captioning service producing short one-line captions for single 512-pixel photos, eight concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for item 37139-imagecaption-qwen3vl8b-1gpu: one vision-language engine on one
# H100 serving short single-image captioning requests. The interpreter that runs it and the
# hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml, which is not portable.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own torch_dtype, pinned so a later default cannot drift it.
dtype: bfloat16

# ~12x what a request reaches. It is not sized for the workload: it is the ceiling the engine's
# startup multimodal profiling pass has to fit a synthetic image into.
max-model-len: 4096

# Deliberately ABOVE scenario.json's 8 streams, so the operating point is the stream count.
max-num-seqs: 16

# Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request: 1`. Keep this value on ONE line.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Caches off: every request carries a different image and a different text body, so neither can
# hit on the part of the prompt that costs anything.
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
